selectedNextSlice.name: exact PNG handout asset registration proposal/session/execute/reread/inverse-restore boundary
selectedNextSlice.scope: Add one typed human/no-provider project-store proposal adapter, exact project proposal-session acceptance, and executor for registering one PNG handout asset on a fresh test-owned project. Bind exact project/generation/content identity, hash-derived asset identity, handout role, label/provenance metadata, and candidate descriptor while keeping candidate bytes and paths behind the typed asset/project-store adapter. Require preview, reviewer approval, authoritative catalog/project/recovery rereads, one atomic save, inverse restore of the original Scene content and active selection, preservation of the newly registered content-addressed asset tree, append-only history, and no Foundry/provider/credential/browser/player-password activity.
selectedNextSlice.reason: After M343, PNG handout registration is the smallest remaining persistent asset producer: it uses the existing image/asset validation boundary, adds no Scene binding or workspace metadata, and can prove role-specific content persistence without collapsing raw bytes into generic proposal history. The native merge-only asset store preserves the new content-addressed entry, so this slice does not invent deletion or cleanup authority.
